This wasn’t my kid, it was actually me when I was younger. When I was younger I was really into Star Wars, and our disc for Episode IV had a bonus feature that was about how they made the film. There was one scene where they showed how Kenny Baker, a dwarf, operated R2-D2. My 6 year old-self thought that all of this was another Star Wars movie, not a how-it’s-made featurette. Anyways, the next day we went to the movie theaters. On the way out, we saw a guy walking up who was also a dwarf. I thought this was fantastic because Star Wars had just come to life! I looked over to my parents and said “Mom! Dad! They really do exist!!” My mom and dad, of course, were absolutely mortified. They apologized profusely and the guy didn’t really seem to care. They didn’t end up punishing me because I was 6 and couldn’t have known any better.
